item.title: philosophy of life: 生活哲学
item.description:
假如生活欺骗了你，不要悲伤，不要心急！忧郁的日子里须要镇静：相信吧，快乐的日子将会来临！心儿永远向往着未来；现在却常是忧郁。一切都是瞬息，一切都将会过去；而那过去了的，就会成为亲切的怀恋。– 普希金(Pushkin, 1799-1837), 假如生活欺骗了你, 1825

No one really teaches me how to live my life. So I learn it bit by bit through mistakes.

小时候对未来没有什么梦想，只是觉得时间过得好慢，急着长大，却不知道要长成什么样的一个人。那时候也会遇到挫折和不开心的时候，大多只能自己安慰自己。有两首诗至今记忆犹新。一是李白的《将进酒》，尤其是那句“天生我材必有用”。另一首就是普希金的《假如生活欺骗了你》，“忧郁的日子里须要镇静：相信吧，快乐的日子将会来临！”我是成长在没有宗教的环境中的，那时对于信仰对于历史几乎一无所知，年轻又没有阅历，看不到自己的未来，更看不清历史的方向。因此也就只能用那两首诗来鼓励自己，一步一步地挪下去，做自己能做的事。现在回头看，当时自己那些“天大的”挫折和别人在文革或战争中所经历的磨难相比，简直不值一提，最多算作成长的烦恼而已。

不信宗教，却应该有一点自己的信仰和处世原则，这些将支撑自己度过那些人生中的黑暗时光。除了上面提到的两首诗，还相信其它什么呢？己所不欲，勿施于人。不劳无获。千里之行始于足下。种瓜可能得豆，东成而西就。塞翁失马，焉知非福。不断学习，不断探索。

笃信好学，守死善道。危邦不入，乱邦不居。天下有道则见，无道则隐。邦有道，贫且贱焉，耻也，邦无道，富且贵焉，耻也。– 孔子

It’s not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters. (人生中遭遇什么并不重要，重要的是如何对待自己的遭遇。) – Epictetus

No man is free who is not master of himself. – Epictetus

Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants. – Epictetus

item.title: what is you?
item.description:
There is going to have the first Dark ID (DID) design. The idea of DID dwelled in my mind for about two years. Now I can finally see its form. I am not sure how others receive it but it’s mine, unique to what I am.

This reminds me of one thing that Jorge Borges said in Spanish. “Sólo perduran en el tiempo las cosas Que no fueron del tiempo.” After translation, it is roughly as follows: Only things that were not of time endure in time. This I believe applies to not only time, but many other things such as life. What you are is what you are.

item.title: Half a story
item.description:
I have been to several cities in my travel.

I lived in a city when I was young. In the north, there’s my childhood in a rural village and a high school. In the east, that’s my home for a while. In the west, I had my best college time. In the south, that’s where my girlfriend lived. At that time, the city was still small. I could walk to my grandma’s house on my little feet from my school. I could ride a bicycle from west to east and back again on the weekends while studying. Not sure how long it took. It was not exhausting. In the wind, in the rain, in the dusk, and I did remember the yellow ginkgo tree just outside the south gate of city walls in the rain. That shining yellow is my favorite colour.

item.title: Fish and Pond
item.description:
Think of your mind like a pond full of fish and each fish is a feeling. Try to be the pond, not the fish.

Life is nothing but time given to us, short or long. For all of us, a day is long and a year is short. We use our days to trade for years. We trade our time for food, clothes, houses and cars. In the end, time is the only thing we do not have.
